meaning.en: A region that makes up part of an area.

sentences.en: In the view of network structure, the subarea routing strategy is a hierarchical routing protocol.

sentences.en: The standing crop of mollusk in subarea of Guozheng Lake, both aquatic oligochaete and aquatic insect in subarea of Shuiguo Lake was maximal.

sentences.en: The particular resource within a subarea that is identified by an element address.
